title: Build the FPL Benchmark Kernel
description:
## What to build

Turn the current Phase 1 scaffolding into a reproducible benchmark kernel for comparing deterministic analytics, optimisation, evidence agents and human decisions under identical point-in-time information.

The kernel must create immutable deadline episodes, execute policy arms under explicit budgets, validate and freeze proposals before outcome reveal, preserve longitudinal policy state, and report paired decision quality, calibration, safety, cost and latency. It must keep browser execution deferred and source collection governed.

Files: docs/evaluation/benchmark-protocol.md, control/schemas/benchmark/**, src/orchestration/**, src/evaluation/**, evals/episodes/**, tests/**
design:
Kernel contract: immutable episode manifest -> arm runner -> deterministic validation -> frozen proposal/GDR -> hidden-outcome reveal -> longitudinal transition -> paired and clustered evaluation.

Required arms: naive baseline; forecast plus optimiser; constrained evidence agent; evidence agent plus challenger; human decision. Historical replay is primary for structured-data arms. Live paired shadow evaluation is primary for evidence-dependent arms.

Every run records episode and snapshot IDs, source hashes, code commit, rules/model/prompt/tool versions, resource budgets, JSONL trace, validation, proposal, outcome, cost, latency, safety events and degraded-mode decisions.
acceptance_criteria:
- Child beads collectively implement the episode contract, genuine replay, longitudinal state, agent arms and evaluation.
- No arm can observe hidden outcomes before its proposal is frozen.
- Every comparison is paired on the same observed episode and reports uncertainty plus resource use.
- Collection remains source-registry gated and browser execution remains deferred.

title: Add CI and authoritative quality gates
description:
## Parent

FPL-bsw — Build the FPL Benchmark Kernel

## What to build

Create a GitHub Actions pipeline that runs the repository's authoritative tests and schema/rules checks on supported Python versions, with deterministic commands suitable for local reproduction. The workflow must fail on any test or contract failure and must not collect live data.

Files: .github/workflows/ci.yml, pyproject.toml, tests/README.md

## Blocked by

None - can start immediately
acceptance_criteria:
- CI runs the complete committed test suite on pushes and pull requests.
- The same documented command runs locally without network-dependent tests.
- Schema, rules, replay and unit failures produce a non-zero exit status.
- No live collector or authenticated browser path runs in CI.

title: Build live FPL episodes from snapshots and manager state
description:
## Parent

FPL-bsw — Build the FPL Benchmark Kernel

## What to build

Construct a valid benchmark episode from a pre-deadline official FPL snapshot plus manual manager-state entry. Resolve selling prices, bank, free transfers, chips, squad and ruleset; compute point-in-time features; preserve source hashes; and keep outcome fields sealed.

Files: src/orchestration/manager_state.py, src/orchestration/episode_builder.py, scripts/build_live_episode.py, control/templates/manager-state-entry.json, tests/integration/test_live_episode_builder.py

## Blocked by

- FPL-bsw.2
- FPL-bsw.3
- FPL-bsw.4
acceptance_criteria:
- A fixture snapshot and valid manual manager state produce a schema-valid episode.
- Invalid or stale manager state fails with actionable diagnostics.
- Every input is at or before the episode cutoff and retains a content hash.
- Outcome references exist but outcome values are unavailable to policy arms.
- No authenticated manager-state collection is introduced.

title: Create genuine historical benchmark episodes
description:
## Parent

FPL-bsw — Build the FPL Benchmark Kernel

## What to build

Build historical episodes from real season/Gameweek data rather than relabelling a synthetic fixture. Apply point-in-time availability filters, identity mappings and season rules; document unavailable pre-deadline evidence; and emit immutable observed and hidden-outcome partitions.

Files: src/orchestration/historical_episode_builder.py, scripts/build_historical_episodes.py, evals/episodes/structured/**, tests/historical-replay/test_historical_episode_builder.py

## Blocked by

- FPL-bsw.3
- FPL-bsw.4
- FPL-bsw.5
acceptance_criteria:
- Each selected season/Gameweek produces materially distinct inputs tied to real source rows.
- Later observations and final outcomes are absent from the observed partition.
- Ruleset, identities, fixture revisions and source hashes are episode-specific.
- Missing historical news is represented as an evidence limitation, not reconstructed by assumption.
- Episode builds are deterministic from registered local data paths.

title: Implement longitudinal policy-state transitions
description:
## Parent

FPL-bsw — Build the FPL Benchmark Kernel

## What to build

Model each policy arm as a stateful season trajectory. After a proposal is frozen and an outcome is revealed, transition squad, purchase and selling prices, bank, free transfers and chips into the next episode without borrowing state from another arm.

Files: src/orchestration/policy_state.py, control/schemas/benchmark/policy-state.json, control/schemas/benchmark/state-transition.json, tests/unit/test_policy_state.py

## Blocked by

- FPL-bsw.2
- FPL-bsw.3
- FPL-bsw.9
acceptance_criteria:
- Every arm begins from an explicit initial state and owns an independent state history.
- Legal transfers, hits, banking and chips transition deterministically under the active ruleset.
- Selling prices use the arm's purchase history rather than a shared proxy.
- Invalid or impossible transitions fail closed.
- Replaying the same transition sequence yields identical state hashes.

title: Replace the pilot smoke test with genuine replay
description:
## Parent

FPL-bsw — Build the FPL Benchmark Kernel

## What to build

Run the complete decision pipeline over real historical episodes in chronological order. Give every policy arm the same observed episode, enforce its own longitudinal state, validate and freeze its proposal, reveal the hidden outcome only afterwards, and persist deterministic artefacts for rerun.

Files: src/orchestration/replay_harness.py, scripts/run_replay_pilot_set.py, scripts/run_replay.py, tests/historical-replay/test_genuine_replay.py, reports/benchmarks/**

## Blocked by

- FPL-bsw.10
- FPL-bsw.11
- FPL-bsw.12
acceptance_criteria:
- The pilot no longer relabels one synthetic optimiser fixture as multiple Gameweeks.
- Distinct historical episodes yield distinct inputs and reproducibility hashes.
- Outcome access before proposal freeze is rejected by tests.
- Each arm advances only its own state between Gameweeks.
- Identical code, episode and cached-agent inputs reproduce identical run artefacts.

title: Add counterfactual outcomes and clustered evaluation
description:
## Parent

FPL-bsw — Build the FPL Benchmark Kernel

## What to build

Score frozen policy decisions against valid counterfactuals and aggregate them using paired, season/Gameweek-aware statistics. Replace the expected-points do-nothing proxy with realised feasible baselines where possible, decompose decisions, report calibration and regret, and keep uncertainty explicit.

Files: src/reporting/baseline_comparison.py, src/evaluation/paired_metrics.py, src/evaluation/calibration.py, src/evaluation/power.py, control/schemas/decisions/decision_outcomes.json, control/schemas/decisions/retrospectives.json, tests/test_benchmark_evaluation.py

## Blocked by

- FPL-bsw.13
acceptance_criteria:
- Do-nothing, captaincy, transfer, bench and chip comparisons use recorded feasible alternatives.
- Metrics are paired on episode and clustered by season/Gameweek or manager as appropriate.
- Reports include uncertainty intervals, effect sizes, calibration, cost and latency rather than season totals alone.
- Detectable-effect-size analysis is recorded before comparative results are interpreted.
- Outcome and retrospective schemas retain the frozen proposal and baseline provenance.

title: Implement the first constrained evidence-agent arm
description:
## Parent

FPL-bsw — Build the FPL Benchmark Kernel

## What to build

Add one evidence-agent benchmark arm after the owner selects provider(s). The arm may query only approved evidence/tools, propose cited and expiring expected-minutes adjustments, run inside explicit budgets, pass deterministic validation, and fall back to the deterministic arm on timeout or failure. Add the challenger as a separately measurable configuration, not an implicit behaviour.

Files: src/agents/evidence_agent.py, src/agents/challenger_agent.py, src/orchestration/agent_arm.py, prompts/evidence-agent/**, prompts/challenger/**, tests/agent-evals/**, evals/golden-cases/agents/**

## Blocked by

- FPL-bsw.7
- FPL-bsw.8
- FPL-bsw.10
- FPL-bsw.14
acceptance_criteria:
- Open Decision 8 is resolved by the owner before provider-specific code or secrets are used.
- The agent cannot mutate rules, apply its own adjustment, approve a proposal or execute FPL changes.
- Every claim and adjustment is cited, timestamped, confidence-scored and expiring.
- Tool, token, cost and latency budgets are enforced with deterministic fallback.
- Single-agent and evidence-plus-challenger arms are independently runnable and ablatable.
- Golden cases cover stale/conflicting evidence, unknown players, rule violations, tool failure and injection attempts.

title: Complete deterministic rules and line-up validation
description:
## Parent

FPL-bsw — Build the FPL Benchmark Kernel

## What to build

Replace catalogue acknowledgements with executable rule checks and complete legal line-up coverage. Validate every legal formation, player uniqueness, XI/bench disjointness, bench composition, captaincy and fixture/deadline edge cases using versioned rules data.

Files: src/scoring/validator.py, src/scoring/golden_runner.py, src/optimisation/simple_plan.py, tests/rules/**, evals/golden-cases/rules-2026-27.yaml

## Blocked by

None - can start immediately
acceptance_criteria:
- Legal formations including 4-5-1 and 5-2-3 pass.
- Duplicate players, XI/bench overlap and invalid bench composition fail deterministically.
- Blank, Double, correction and deadline cases execute assertions rather than catalogue acknowledgements.
- All validation limits are loaded from the active ruleset.

title: Define the benchmark experiment and episode contract
description:
## Parent

FPL-bsw — Build the FPL Benchmark Kernel

## What to build

Specify the benchmark kernel as a fixed experiment protocol and machine-readable episode contract. Define observed inputs, hidden outcomes, policy arms, budgets, freeze semantics, reproducibility fields, comparison units and historical-versus-live evidence limits. Record material choices in an ADR for owner ratification.

Files: docs/evaluation/benchmark-protocol.md, docs/decisions/0017-benchmark-kernel.md, control/schemas/benchmark/episode-manifest.json, control/schemas/benchmark/policy-result.json, tests/contracts/test_benchmark_schemas.py

## Blocked by

None - can start immediately
acceptance_criteria:
- The protocol defines naive, forecast-plus-optimiser, evidence-agent, evidence-plus-challenger and human arms.
- Episode schemas require cutoff/deadline, source hashes, manager state, ruleset, point-in-time features, allowed tools and hidden outcome reference.
- Outcome isolation and proposal freeze are testable invariants.
- Owner ratifies or amends ADR-0017 before dependent episode builders merge.

title: Correct and extend forecast evaluation
description:
## Parent

FPL-bsw — Build the FPL Benchmark Kernel

## What to build

Correct target definitions and evaluation leakage, then add proper scoring and calibration for event forecasts. Starting probability must use actual starts rather than a 60-minute proxy; custom data roots must propagate through evaluation; Elo outcome probabilities must form a coherent distribution; and fixture effects must be benchmarked rather than fixed by an unexplained constant.

Files: src/forecasting/data.py, src/forecasting/evaluate.py, src/forecasting/minutes.py, src/forecasting/player_events.py, src/forecasting/team_strength.py, tests/test_forecasting_baselines.py, docs/data-sources/wp05/**

## Blocked by

None - can start immediately
acceptance_criteria:
- Start targets distinguish starting XI from minutes played.
- Event probabilities report proper scores and calibration diagnostics.
- Team-strength probabilities are normalised and explicitly handle draws.
- A caller-supplied historical data root is honoured end to end.
- Time-split tests demonstrate no post-deadline feature leakage.

title: Govern the next dataset intake
description:
## Parent

FPL-bsw — Build the FPL Benchmark Kernel

## What to build

Turn the dataset roadmap into governed source-registry decisions and bounded acquisition experiments. Prioritise official FPL snapshots and manager state, then timestamped market/team-strength baselines and expected-minutes evidence. Treat event data as a later ablation-driven enrichment, not a default dependency.

Files: control/sources/source-registry.yaml, docs/data-sources/dataset-roadmap.md, docs/decisions/0018-benchmark-datasets.md, docs/data-sources/profiles/**

## Blocked by

None - can start immediately
acceptance_criteria:
- Tier 0 covers official bootstrap, fixtures, live, prices/status/news/ownership, manager state and final outcomes with cadence and retention rules.
- Tier 1 assesses football-data.co.uk, timestamped Betfair historical odds and ClubElo with licence and point-in-time limitations.
- Tier 2 defines official line-up/minutes, club injury/press-conference, cup/Europe/international load, travel/rest and role-change evidence.
- StatsBomb open data is registered for method prototyping; commercial EPL event data requires a demonstrated ablation need.
- Unknown or restricted sources remain disabled.

title: Record browser feasibility without enabling execution
description:
## Parent

FPL-bsw — Build the FPL Benchmark Kernel

## What to build

Document the authenticated FPL squad-selection dry run as Phase 7 feasibility evidence: readable state, player search, reversible add/remove, pitch/list toggle, Auto Pick staging, disabled/enabled submission control and successful reset. Preserve the boundary that no submission was made and define the prerequisites for future automation testing.

Files: docs/architecture/deferred/browser-feasibility.md, docs/architecture/deferred/browser-dry-run.md, docs/decisions/0015-browser-dry-run-stability.md

## Blocked by

None - can start immediately
acceptance_criteria:
- The note records exactly which read and reversible UI interactions were observed.
- It states that Enter Squad was not selected and no account change was committed.
- Selector volatility, authentication, screenshots, ambiguous writes, no-retry and read-back risks are captured.
- Browser execution remains disabled until Phase 7 prerequisites and explicit approval are satisfied.

title: Enforce temporal evidence and fail-closed review
description:
## Parent

FPL-bsw — Build the FPL Benchmark Kernel

## What to build

Make evidence expiry and challenger outcomes operational rather than descriptive. Claims must use source publication times, decisions must exclude or explicitly degrade on stale evidence, unresolved challenges must block approval, and injection handling must validate structured content rather than depend on a single regex canary.

Files: src/evidence/lifecycle.py, control/policies/evidence-adjustments.yaml, control/schemas/evidence/**, control/schemas/decisions/agent_reviews.json, tests/test_evidence_lifecycle.py, evals/golden-cases/evidence/**

## Blocked by

- FPL-bsw.3
acceptance_criteria:
- Published-at defaults are never silently replaced by observed-at.
- Expired evidence cannot alter a projection or support approval.
- Missing or unresolved challenger review blocks the approval path when review is required.
- Conflicts remain visible and resolve only to policy-defined outcomes.
- Injection golden cases test structured isolation and tool permissions, not one phrase match.

title: Expand agent-run trace and budget contracts
description:
## Parent

FPL-bsw — Build the FPL Benchmark Kernel

## What to build

Make each agent condition replayable from recorded context rather than a thin summary. Capture episode/snapshot identity, provider and model, prompt/tool/policy versions, input and output hashes, tool calls and cached responses, token/cost/latency budgets, degraded operation and failure taxonomy.

Files: control/schemas/decisions/agent_runs.json, control/schemas/examples/agent_runs.json, control/schemas/benchmark/run-manifest.json, tests/contracts/test_agent_run_trace.py, docs/evaluation/agent-run-trace.md

## Blocked by

- FPL-bsw.3
acceptance_criteria:
- The schema rejects traces missing episode, model, prompt, tool, budget or hash provenance.
- Cached model responses and ordered tool calls are sufficient to replay without resampling.
- Timeout, tool failure, source failure and budget exhaustion have structured outcomes.
- Secrets, cookies and personal data are explicitly prohibited and tested.

title: Make optimiser search safe and accurately labelled
description:
## Parent

FPL-bsw — Build the FPL Benchmark Kernel

## What to build

Replace unsafe candidate truncation with a search that cannot discard affordable optimal moves before financial checks. Turn ruleset mismatch and player availability into explicit policy outcomes, remove or implement inert constraints, and label results as optimal only within the search space actually explored.

Files: src/optimisation/solver.py, src/optimisation/transfers.py, src/optimisation/simple_plan.py, src/optimisation/types.py, tests/test_optimiser.py, evals/golden-cases/optimiser-*.json, docs/optimisation/wp07-status.md

## Blocked by

- FPL-bsw.2
acceptance_criteria:
- Affordable lower-ranked candidates remain discoverable when higher-ranked candidates are unaffordable.
- Ruleset mismatch fails closed unless an explicit compatibility policy permits it.
- Availability is constrained or penalised according to a recorded policy.
- Unused constraints are removed or exercised by tests.
- Output distinguishes global optimum from highest EV in a declared candidate pool.
